solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One strips off reflectively, in a dream?

parts.note: one is the indefinite article a

indicators.note: as in a mirror's reflection, the word for strips off is read backwards

parts.note: peels means strips off, as of skin or bark

explanation.surface: Someone peeling off their clothes while lost in thought, wondering if it is a dream.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sleeping is in a dream state; both phrases describe a person who is not awake.

clue.text: Game's up before four play air on violin

indicators.note: before puts the reversed game ahead of the Roman numeral
in a down clue up means the word for the game is read from the bottom

parts.note: darts is a pub game
IV is four in Roman numerals

indicators.note: to play with letters is to rearrange them, here those of air

explanation.surface: A concert where the game is over before four musicians play a tune on the violin.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stradivarius is a famous violin made by Antonio Stradivari of Cremona.

clue.text: Poetic not to translate poem!

indicators.note: translating renders words in another form, so the remaining letters are rearranged once to is excluded

explanation.surface: A plea that poetry should not be translated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not to' asks for the letters T and O to be removed from Poetic before the remaining letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An epic is a long narrative poem, like the Iliad or Beowulf.

clue.text: Energetic person might reach home

parts.note: might means strength or power
a house is a home

explanation.surface: A lively person who might manage to get home.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynamic, highly energetic person is called a dynamo or powerhouse.

clue.text: Way a termite initially and another insect were standing on four feet!

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of termite

parts.note: an ant is another insect besides the termite

explanation.surface: A road where two insects stand on all fours.
explanation.walkthrough: Statant is a heraldic term for an animal standing with all four feet on the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry an animal shown standing with all four feet down is described with this term.

clue.text: Set coming from Far East maddeningly distant

indicators.note: maddeningly suggests letters driven wild into a new order after the others leave

explanation.surface: A group of people travelling from the Orient, frustratingly remote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming from' asks for the letters of Set to be taken out of Far East; the rest are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Afar means at a great distance, far away, an adverb of remoteness.

clue.text: Record Paul removed of method of conducting business

indicators.note: removed signals that the letters are moved out of their places and rearranged

explanation.surface: Paul has been struck off the official record of how business is done.
explanation.definitionFit: Procedural relates to procedure, the set ways meetings or courts conduct business.

clue.text: Remain wearing single corset?

parts.note: a corset is called stays, so a single one is a stay
something being worn is on

explanation.surface: Keeping on a lone corset.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay on is to remain in a place or post beyond the expected time.

clue.text: No longer available from Mark

definitions.meaning: said of a book no longer being published or sold
literally coming from a mark or impression, i.e. emerging from a print

explanation.surface: A shop explaining that something can no longer be bought from a supplier named Mark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a person's name; read as a print or impression, something taken from it comes out of print.
explanation.definitionFit: A book that the publisher has stopped producing is no longer available to buy new.

clue.text: Team ordering synthetic cream

indicators.note: putting letters into a new order signals that the two words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sports team putting in an order for artificial cream.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known English Premier League football club, so a sports team.

clue.text: See 10
Sweetheart initially going to Ireland

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word going

parts.note: IRL is the international vehicle code for Ireland

explanation.surface: A sweetheart heading off to Ireland at first.
explanation.definitionFit: A girlfriend is a sweetheart, so a young woman one is courting fits the term.

clue.text: After having fired, has to set off indicator

parts.note: something fired has been lit
must means has to

indicators.note: off suggests the letters of set are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: After a gun goes off, a signal is triggered.
explanation.definitionFit: A decisive test, or the litmus paper itself, which indicates acidity by colour.

clue.text: Pass to first person below and cast-off

parts.note: a request to pass something to me, the first person, is hand me
down means below

explanation.surface: An instruction to pass something to me, beneath, and then throw it away.
explanation.definitionFit: A cast-off garment is one passed on second-hand from an older sibling.

clue.text: Dirt's on one fish or another

indicators.note: in a down clue on places the first piece above the second

parts.note: mud is dirt, and the possessive gives the letter s
a kipper is a smoked herring, one fish

explanation.surface: Dirt lying on one fish or another.
explanation.definitionFit: Another fish is meant: this amphibious goby lives on tidal mudflats.

clue.text: See Rechabite start outside the cloth

indicators.note: outside puts the word for start around the other pieces

parts.note: to start is to flinch, to wince
to eye something is to see it
Rechabites were a temperance society, so a Rechabite is teetotal, TT

explanation.surface: Watch a teetotaller jump outside the fabric shop.
explanation.walkthrough: The Independent Order of Rechabites was a British temperance friendly society; teetotal is shortened to TT.
explanation.definitionFit: Winceyette is a soft brushed cotton fabric used for nightwear.

clue.text: Sit through lecturer having a drink

parts.note: stout is a dark beer, a drink

explanation.surface: Enduring a long lecture by someone who is drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure an event until its end is to sit through it, staying to the finish.

clue.text: Worshipping false rain-god

indicators.note: a false arrangement of the letters is not their true order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Idolaters venerating a false god of rain.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore is to worship, so adoring is a present participle meaning worshipping.

clue.text: Ancient city ceremony that is in the ascendant, I concluded

indicators.note: concluded places the letter I at the end

parts.note: pomp means ceremonial display

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the abbreviation is read upwards

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A rising ceremony, which I completed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman city near Naples buried by Vesuvius in AD 79 was this ancient town.

clue.text: In which small notes are recorded?

definitions.text: In which small notes are recorded?

parts.words: In which small notes are recorded?
parts.note: small reads as minute (tiny), but the book holds the minutes, the notes of a meeting

explanation.surface: A notebook for writing tiny jottings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small' suggests minute meaning tiny; the book is where minutes of meetings are recorded.
explanation.definitionFit: Minutes are the official record of a meeting, kept in a dedicated register.

clue.text: Motorway madness seen in desert?

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's first motorway, with the 1 read as the letter I
rage means madness or fury

explanation.surface: Road rage on the motorway spotted in a deserted place.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds.
explanation.definitionFit: An optical illusion of water is typically seen in the desert heat.

clue.text: Look at all times after first light

indicators.note: after places the poetic word for always behind the picked letter
first picks the opening letter of the word light

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, at all times

explanation.surface: Keeping watch constantly from the break of dawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A leer is a sly or lascivious look, so the noun can stand for a glance.

clue.text: Stand or sit

definitions.meaning: to sit is to take a break and relax

explanation.surface: A choice between standing or sitting down.
explanation.definitionFit: A rest is a support, and to rest is to sit down and relax.

clue.text: Provided with information held by violent despot

parts.note: kept means held

indicators.note: violent suggests the letters of despot are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: A prisoner of a brutal tyrant being briefed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being kept informed of developments means receiving updates, i.e. given news.

clue.text: Fruit grounded down under

definitions.meaning: a fuzzy green fruit also called Chinese gooseberry
a flightless bird of New Zealand, so grounded and from down under

explanation.surface: Fruit brought down to earth in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit is named after New Zealand's flightless national bird.

clue.text: It supports the chairman

parts.note: suggests a loyal backer of the chair of a meeting, but literally the thing a person in a chair sits on

explanation.surface: A loyal backer of the person chairing a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A chair's sitting surface physically holds up whoever sits on it.

clue.text: Pen for another good entertainer sounds OK

parts.note: a host entertains guests

indicators.note: sounds signals that a word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: right means OK or correct

explanation.surface: A good entertainer's voice seems acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: To write on someone else's behalf, uncredited, is to compose under another's name.

clue.text: Rogue horse started late

indicators.note: starting late means missing the beginning, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a trotter is a horse bred for harness racing

explanation.surface: A wayward racehorse that was slow out of the stalls.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotter is a scoundrel, an old-fashioned British term for a villain.
